data.long_meaning: Aafii (عافي) is a form of the Arabic ʿāfī, from the root ʿ-f-y/w, meaning 'healthy, sound' — and, as a participle of ʿafā, 'one who heals'. It shares its root with the well-known noun ʿāfiyah, 'good health'.

faq.q: What does the name Aafii mean?
faq.a: Aafii means Healthy; sound; healer (from ʿāfiyah).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aafii?
What language does the name Aafii come from?
faq.a: Aafii is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aafii a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafii is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aafii written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aafii is written عافي in Arabic and عافی in Urdu, and आफ़ी in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aafii?
faq.a: The root of Aafii is ع-ف-ي (ʿ-f-y).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aafii?
faq.a: From the Arabic root ʿ-f-y/w, as in ʿāfiyah, good health.

faq.q: Does Aafii appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic name; from the root ʿ-f-y/w, the root of ʿāfiyah (well-being).
No. Aafii is from the root ʿ-f-y and means 'healthy, sound', sharing its root with ʿāfiyah, 'good health'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aafii?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafii total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aafii?
faq.a: Aafii appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aafi, Afee.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aafii?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aafii include Aafiaht, Aafa.

faq.q: Is Aafii the same as Aafiaht?
faq.a: They share the root ʿ-f-y/w: Aafii is 'healthy, sound', while Aafiaht renders the noun ʿāfiyah, 'good health'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aafii used today?
faq.a: Aafii is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
